Bug and root cause

In share-wishlist-modal.vue, revokesCurrentAudience was true for any change away from a shared scope, including a widening to Anyone with link that shuts nobody out. The sharing key survives the change, so every link already sent became public while the dialog said everyone would lose access. The fix adds widensToAnyone (no confirmation when widening) and revokesTargets (dropping a recipient inside Specific customers now confirms), and rewrites the swap copy.
